title: Service Contracts: Extending the Contract Term
content:
The term of an AHL Service Contract can be lengthened by an extension amendment. This page sets the period in which an extension may be requested, how far a single extension may reach and how many extensions a contract may receive.

## Clauses

- **Request window.** An extension can be requested only from the opening day of the tier's extension window onward. To find the opening day, take the expiry date on the contract record and count the tier's window days backward on the calendar. A request made on the opening day is within the window; a request made on any earlier day is not.
- **Reach of one extension.** A single extension moves the expiry date later by no more than the tier's maximum number of calendar days.
- **Number of extensions.** Over its life a contract can receive no more extensions than the tier allows.
- **Effect.** An extension is an amendment to the contract; once it is filed, the expiry date on the contract becomes the new, later date.

## Extension terms by tier

| Tier | Window opens (calendar days before expiry) | Longest single extension (calendar days) | Extensions per contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 30 | 30 | 1 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 30 | 30 | 1 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 45 | 60 | 1 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 60 | 90 | 2 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 60 | 90 | 2 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 90 | 120 | 3 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- A Regional Account contract expires on 31 December. Counting 45 calendar days back gives 16 November as the opening day: a request on 16 November is within the window, a request on 15 November is not.
- A Key Account contract expiring on 30 June may be extended to 28 September at the latest, 90 calendar days later. An extension to 30 September would reach further than one extension allows.
- A Strategic Partner contract that has already received three extensions cannot receive a fourth.
- A Standard contract extended once has used its only extension.
